sections.title: Time spend, World and Phylosophy
body: Time spend changes throught time when different technologies arrives. The next changes must come in the following years, with automatization of very repetitive tasks. Today we spend  8-9 hours working, 8 hours sleeping, 2 hours cooking and eating, 1 hour in transporting and the time remaining for people you care and your leisure activities.

Right know you can build, control and programming throught your phone, in a raspy, and in your computer with AI. This changes a lot of productivity related with the production of products and code, with intermitent instructions to the LLM the core of the building of the final product, not the action of programming

Plus, all the intellectual activities must be improved with the interaction of IA. Read, construct concept maps, connect ideas and resume knowledge are so much accesible, and more easy to search and construct. In the last year I reconnect with the reading activities expanding the connection of phylosophy, maths and science, with a new level of interpretation and interconection I never can allow to build without so much time.
